cost: Text parsing linear bytes; lint pair comparisons quadratic in options and string lengths plus glued scans. apply_edits clones/splits text and scans fields per edit, with final join linear bytes. Filesystem cost proportional to bytes transferred; no atomic/durable write guarantee.
description: option_line trims key/fields for three case-sensitive kinds. canon moves a uniquely starred answer to position one and strips leading stars; zero/multiple marked options remain unchanged. Tally compares Unicode scalar counts. Lint reports structural and heuristic findings; spacing fixer normalizes option lines. Edits fold in table order on a working text and return either complete edited text or accumulated refusals. File edit command processes files in BTreeMap order with per-file writes. Restore validates line count and indices before copying requested saved lines. Wave34 adds five nested helper groupants and exact selected native evidence; prior epochs remain historical.

inverse: Universe is finite UTF-8 text, edit lists and supplied fixture filesystem transitions under successful allocations. Inner absence excludes successful replacement with forbidden separators, ambiguous old text, duplicate case-folded options or invalid line indices. Lint clean does not prove correctness of teaching content; errors in later files do not undo earlier writes.

Canonicalization loses whitespace, original marked position and repeated leading stars. Tally loses every question and option string beyond length order. Successful edit result with unknown edits has many earlier texts; snapshot restore reconstructs selected saved lines only, not external file history.
limitations: Partial source models and finite native evidence; no live lesson edits, parser, teacher, run-course, GPU or held-out benchmarks.
External filesystem errors can preserve earlier effects; syntax is partial, macro bodies opaque.
state: Pure apply_edits exposes no partially changed string on Err; command-level edit is not all-files atomic. Original option positions and star of replaced answer are preserved for supported edits. Restore rejects zero and out-of-range indices before writing.
